spans.s: भिद् (I) vt. 1P (pres. भिंदति) To divide, to cut into parts.

भिद् (II) vt. 7U (pp. भिन्न; pres. भिनत्ति, भिंत्ते; (desid. बिभित्सि) 1. To break, to rend, to tear, to cut asunder, हत्वा च्छित्वा च भित्वा च M.iii.33, R.v.55, xii.77; 2. to break down or through, to transgress, निहतश्व स्थितिं भिंदन्दानवोऽसौ बलद्विषा Bt.vii.68; 3. to divide, to separate, R.i.39, xiv.3; 4. to offer; 5. to cause to blossom or expand, सूर्यांशुभिर्भिन्नमिवारविंदम् K.S.i.32, भित्वा सद्यः किसलयपुटान् देवदारुद्रुमाणाम् Megh.ii.44; 6. to divide into parts; 7. to change, to alter, भिंदंति मंदां गतिमश्वमुख्यः K.S.i.11, अभिन्नगतयः शब्दं संहते मृगाः Sak.i.; 8. to perplex; 9. to distinguish; 10. to become loose, to be loosened, प्रस्थानभिन्नां न बबंध नीवीम् R.vii.9, 66; 11. to interrupt, to disturb, समयं लक्ष्मणोऽभिनत् R.xv.94; 12. to disclose, to betray, न रहस्यं भेत्स्यति D.K.; 13. to set at variance.With अनु-, to break down.With उद्-, to grow (as vegetation).With निस्-, to tear up, to tear asunder, Bt.ix.67.With प्र-, 1. to break, to tear, to tear asunder; 2. to flow from the temples of an elephant.With प्रति-, 1. to pierce through; 2. to disclose; 3. to reproach, to censure, प्रत्यभैत्सुरवदंत्य एव तम् R.xix.22, Sis.ix.58; 4. to disown, to reject.With वि-, 1. to break; 2. to pierce; 3. to interrupt; 4. to disperse.With सम्-, 1. to break to pieces, to break asunder; 2. to bring together, to join, to combine, to mix, Bt.vii.5.

भिद् Pass. (भिद्यते) 1. to be split; 2. to be divided or separated; 3. to be destroyed; 4. to expand, to blossom; 5. to become loose; 6. to be different from, (with an abl.); 7. to be divulged, to be public, e.g. षट्कर्णो भिद्यते मंत्रः.
भिद् Caus. (भेदयति-ते) 1. to divide, to tear; 2. to destroy; 3. to set at variance; 4. to seduce.
भिदक (II) n. 1. A diamond; 2. Indra’s thunderbolt.
भिदा f. 1. Breaking, bursting, tearing; 2. separation; 3. difference; 4. kind, species.
भिदुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Breaking, splitting; 2. fragile, brittle; 3. mixed, mingled, नीलाश्मद्युतिभिदुरांभसोऽपरत्र Sis.iv.26.
भिदुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Breaking, splitting; 2. fragile, brittle; 3. mixed, mingled, नीलाश्मद्युतिभिदुरांभसोऽपरत्र Sis.iv.26.
भिद्य m. 1. A rushing river; 2. the name of a particular river, तोयदागम इवोद्धद्यभिद्ययोर्नामधेयसदृशं विचेष्टितम् R.xi.8.
